1.text: Dawidi yabwiye Uwiteka amagambo y'iyi ndirimbo, umunsi Uwiteka yamukirije amaboko y'abanzi be bose n'aya Sawuli, aravuga ati

2.text: “Uwiteka ni igitare cyanjye,Ni igihome cyanjye,Ni umukiza wanjye ubwanjye.

3.text: Ni Imana igitare cyanjye,Ni yo nziringira.Ni yo ngabo inkingira,Ni ihembe ry'agakiza kanjye,Ni igihome cyanjye kirekire kinkingira,Ni ubuhungiro bwanjye.Ni umukiza wanjye unkiza urugomo.

4.text: Ndambaza Uwiteka, ukwiriye gushimwa,Ni ko nzakizwa abanzi banjye.

6.text: Ingoyi z'ikuzimu zantaye hagati,Ibigoyi by'urupfu byantanze imbere.

7.text: Mu mubabaro wanjye nambaje Uwiteka,Ni koko natakiye Imana yanjye,Yumvira ijwi ryanjye mu rusengero rwayo,Ibyo nayitakiye biyinjira mu matwi.

8.text: “Maze isi iratigita, ihinda umushyitsi,Imfatiro z'ijuru ziranyeganyega,Zitigiswa n'uburakari bwayo.

9.text: Umwotsi ucumba mu mazuru yayo,Umuriro uva mu kanwa kayo, uratwika,Havamo n'amakara yaka.

10.text: Yunamisha ijuru, iramanuka,Umwijima w'icuraburindi wari munsi y'ibirenge byayo.

11.text: Iguruka ihetswe na Kerubi,Ni ukuri ibonwa ku mababa y'umuyaga.

12.text: Umwijima iwugira ihema ryayo riyigose,Igotwa n'ibirundo by'amazi,Ni byo bicu bya rukokoma byo mu ijuru.

13.text: Ubwiza burabagirana buri imbere yayo,Butuma amakara yaka.

14.text: Uwiteka ahindishiriza inkuba mu ijuru,Usumbabyose avuga ijwi rye.

15.text: Arasa imyambi ye arabatatanya,Ni yo mirabyo ibakura umutima.

16.text: Maze ubutaka bwo hasi y'inyanja buraboneka,Imfatiro z'isi ziratwikururwa,Ku bwo guhana k'Uwiteka,Ku bw'inkubi y'umwuka uva mu mazuru ye.

17.text: “Ari mu ijuru, arambura ukuboko aramfata,Ankura mu mazi y'isanzure.

18.text: Ankiza umwanzi wanjye ukomeye n'abanyambaraga,Kuko bandushaga amaboko.

19.text: Bari baranteye ku munsi nagiriyeho amakuba,Ariko Uwiteka ni we wambereye ubwishingikirizo.

20.text: Abinkuramo anshyira ahantu hagari,Yankirije kuko yanyishimiraga.

21.text: “Uwiteka yangororeye ibikwiye gukiranuka kwanjye,Nk'uko amaboko yanjye atanduye,Ni ko yangiriye.

22.text: Kuko nitondeye inzira z'Uwiteka,Kandi ntakoze icyaha cyo kureka Imana yanjye,

23.text: Kuko amateka yayo yose yari imbere yanjye,Kandi amategeko yayo sinyaveho.

25.text: Ni cyo cyatumye Uwiteka anyitura ibikwiriye gukiranuka kwanjye,Kandi ibikwiriye kutandura kwanjye imbere ye.

26.text: “Ku munyambabazi uziyerekana nk'umunyambabazi,Ku utunganye, uziyerekana nk'utunganye,

27.text: Ku utanduye, uziyerekana nk'utanduye.Ku kigoryi, uziyerekana nk'ugoramye.

28.text: Abacishijwe bugufi ni bo uzakiza,Ariko igitsure cyawe kiri ku bibone,Kugira ngo ubacishe bugufi.

29.text: Ni wowe tabaza ryanjye, Uwiteka,Uwiteka ni we uvira umwijima wanjye.

30.text: Kuko ari wowe umpa gutwaranira umutwe w'ababisha,Kandi ari wowe Imana yanjye impa gusimbuka inkike z'ibihome.

31.text: “Inzira y'Imana itungana rwose,Ijambo ry'Uwiteka ryaravugutiwe,Ni ingabo ikingira abamwiringira bose.

32.text: Ni nde Mana itari Uwiteka?Ni nde gitare kitari Imana yacu?

33.text: Imana ni igihome cyanjye gikomeye,Ishorerera umukiranutsi mu nzira yayo.

34.text: Ihindura ibirenge bye nk'iby'imparakazi,Impagarika ku misozi yanjye.

35.text: Yigisha amaboko yanjye kurasana,Bituma amaboko yanjye afora umuheto w'icyuma.

36.text: Kandi wampaye ingabo inkingira,Ni yo gakiza kawe,Ubugwaneza bwawe bwampinduye ukomeye.

37.text: Intambwe zanjye wazāguriye inzira,Ibirenge byanjye ntibyanyereye.

38.text: “Nirukanye ababisha banjye ndabarimbura,Sinagaruka kugeza aho barimbukiye.

39.text: Narabarimbuye ndabamenagura babura uko babyuka,Ni koko baguye munsi y'ibirenge byanjye.

40.text: Wankenyeje imbaraga zo kurwana,Abampagurukiye bakantera warabancogoreje.

41.text: Watumye ababisha banjye bampa ibitugu,Kugira ngo ndimbure abanyanga.

43.text: Maze mbasya nk'umukungugu,Mbaribata nk'ibyondo byo mu nzira, ndabatatanya.

44.text: “Kandi wankijije imirwano y'abantu banjye,Wandindirije kuzaba umutware w'amahanga,Ishyanga ntigeze kumenya rizankorera.

45.text: Abanyamahanga bazanyoboka,Nibamara kumva inkuru yanjye, bazanyumvira.

46.text: Abanyamahanga bazacogora,Bazava mu bihome byabo bahinde imishyitsi.

47.text: “Uwiteka ahoraho, Igitare cyanjye gihimbazwe,Imana y'igitare cy'agakiza kanjye ishyirwe hejuru.

48.text: Ni yo Mana imporera,Ikangomorera amahanga nkayatwara,

49.text: Ikankura mu babisha banjye.Ni koko unshyira hejuru y'abampagurukiye,Unkiza umunyarugomo.

50.text: Ni cyo kizatuma ngushimira mu mahanga, Uwiteka,Ndirimba ishimwe ry'izina ryawe.

51.text: Uwo yimitse amuha agakiza gakomeye,Agirira imbabazi uwo yimikishije amavuta,Ni we Dawidi n'urubyaro rwe iteka ryose.”
